objective: Reproduce original marine olfactophore geometry, original calculated thresholds, then score new molecules in 3D

required_before_claiming_original_model_.required_content: Native hypothesis/project export, or complete feature coordinates in angstrom, feature types, tolerance radii, directional vectors, optional/required mapping rules, excluded-volume centers/radii and all model weights
Original quantitative activity/threshold mapping, all coefficients/intercept, units, transform, fit normalization, treatment of unmapped features and parameter precision

Original molecular structures with atom mapping, stereo/protonation, selected and generated conformers, aligned 3D coordinates, energy/force-field/conformer settings, activities and training membership

Available licensed Catalyst/Discovery Studio pharmacophore execution engine, exact original version where reproducibility requires it, protocols, feature dictionary, random seeds and manual editing history

required_before_claiming_original_model_.limitation: Transcribed printed rounded values and R-group notation, not a complete structure/conformer or model archive

required_before_claiming_original_model_.required_content: Original aligned ligands plus saved camera/projection, molecule/feature display radii, transparency, colors, clipping and labels

prohibited_shortcuts: No coordinates or model weights invented from a picture and labeled original
No regressor trained on the published calculated column to mimic the original software
No manual adjustment of model coordinates to improve image resemblance
No claim of quantitative threshold prediction from a geometry-only fit
No numerical-equivalence claim based only on an image or one correlation
acceptance_gates: Original hypothesis provenance and completeness verified
Feature geometry and excluded volumes equivalent under a proper rigid transform, with numerical tolerances documented
Per-ligand mapping and printed calculated thresholds reproduced within documented rounding, not merely the reported correlation
New molecule inference performs actual 3D conformer search and pharmacophore fitting; returns pose, conformer, feature mapping and model-derived quantitative output
Saved rendering verified against original only after numerical gates
Predictive performance for new molecules reported separately from reproduction of fitted training values
